summary: Pulse AI v0.2 correction-pack regression: full backend (24/24 pytest) and frontend (Playwright) coverage. All five corrections verified — non-overlapping economics, evidence-bound brief validation, honest offline evaluation, deterministic-default + budgeted AI synthesis, and proof-based intervention closure. Cockpit, leakages, journeys URL drilldown, debug-drawer reset, evaluation page, mobile bottom-nav and input validation (bad region -> 422) all pass.

issues: Pressing Escape leaves the drawer's full-page bg-ink/30 backdrop in the DOM (under .brief-panel), which can intercept clicks on the funnel buttons until an explicit close button is clicked. Functional via the close button; only impacts Esc-based dismissal.

action_items: OPTIONAL: ensure EvidenceDrawer also closes on Escape (currently the backdrop remains in DOM until the explicit close button is used).
critical_code_review_comments: engine.py opportunity model is internally consistent: waterfall telescopes to the benchmark delta, unique pools are the only additive groups, clinic allocation never exceeds regional show pool, and high_cost_per_attended is correctly flagged 'diagnostic' with zero pool.
brief_validation.py: comprehensive provenance/schema/numeric/privacy/confidence rejection paths; tests exercise each failure mode.
server.py: /api/brief default is deterministic; use_model=true and MODEL_DISABLED falls back gracefully; budget endpoint accurate; daily limit/cooldown/cache scaffold present.

Interventions state machine enforces no-direct-Closed (transition buttons stop at Proof Required; closure requires /proof claim + /verify approve); session-scoped overrides leave seed unaffected for other sessions.
Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL throughout; X-Demo-Session-ID header is automatically attached.

All required data-testids present (opportunity-summary, opp-total, rel-*, brief-mode, brief-reason, metric-chip-*, evidence-chip-*, run-ai-synthesis-btn, suggested-question, brief-ask-btn, funnel-stage-chip, debug-open, reset-demo-btn, owner-select, assign-intervention-btn, transition-*, proof-form, proof-days-input, claim-closure-btn, verify-block, verify-approve-btn, eval-disclaimer, release-ready, relationship-banner).
test_credentials: N/A — anonymous demo session via X-Demo-Session-ID header (browser localStorage UUID).
seed_data_creation: Frontend playwright run mutated session 'pw-proof-001' to drive LEAK-005 (INT-0003) through Detected -> Assigned -> In Progress -> Proof Required -> Closure Claimed -> Closed. Session 'pw-fresh-1234' consumed 1 AI synthesis budget (24/25 remaining). Default/anonymous session is unaffected by these per-session overrides.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_pulse_api.py is exhaustive and passes against the live engine with MODEL_ENABLED=false (forced in conftest). For frontend, use a fresh X-Demo-Session-ID (set localStorage 'pulse_demo_session' via add_init_script) before running the proof-closure flow to avoid colliding with seed mutations from previous runs. AI synthesis returns either 'AI synthesis · Claude' or 'Deterministic fallback' with a brief-reason chip (both are PASS per PRD). Don't spam Run AI synthesis — 20s cooldown applies per session.
rca of the issue: No critical issues. The minor evidence-drawer Escape behavior is cosmetic — the explicit close button works and overlays don't appear during normal user flow (only when automated tests rely on Escape).
